full_judgment: The predecessor of the present appellant Nos. 1-6, namely, Alhaj Md. Younus Mia as plaintiff (pre-emptor) filed that suit under Mahomedan Law stating inter alia that, the land appertaining to SA Khatian No. 359 originally belonged to the plaintiff and his full-brother, the defendant No. 2 herein the respondent No. 2. Subsequently, the defendant No. 2 (herein referred to as "seller") sold out 5.32 acres of land appertaining to Plot No. 1320 to the defendant-respondent No. 1 (herein referred to as the "purchaser") without informing the said transfer to the plaintiff. In the suit land, the plaintiff has homestead whereas, the defendant No. 1 is a stranger purchaser in the suit land and the same is used for the communication of the local people, supply of water for cultivation where there remained a haystack as well. On 17-2-2009, after completing court's job, the plaintiff (who being an Advocate by profession) accompanied by his Moharar (clerk) named, Atahar Miah went to the suit plot bearing No. 1320 and found that the defendant No. 1 and other pLi.:,ons are setting up haystack. The plaintiff then asked one, Shahidul Islam in presence of the defendant No. 1 and others about their reason of gathering there, when the defendant No. I apprised him that he purchased the suit land where paddy straws were being stuck. The plaintiff then instantly jumped on the suit property expressing his desire to pre-empt the same and thus performed "Talab-i-Mowasibat" and after obtaining the certified copy of the disputed deed on 26-9-2009, he came to learn about the transfer of the suit land dated 15-7-2008 and as a shafi then filed the suit.
